component.name: RestifEye
component.summary: Break reminders that respect your flow

description.p: RestifEye reminds you to rest your eyes and move your body at healthy intervals — without being annoying and without breaking on Wayland. It defers breaks while you are in a call, credits breaks you take on your own, always warns before taking the screen, and shows a simple illustrated exercise with every break.
Includes automatic screen-time tracking with weekly, monthly, and yearly analytics plus practical advice — all computed locally. No accounts, no telemetry.
